title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.53
summary: Clearer Options, consistent menus and artwork styles, and refresh controls that keep your place.

sections.heading: Options made for your remote
bullets: Play, Play using, Details and Choose genre stay easy to reach. Genre stays out of episode navigation.
Save, Trakt, discovery, recommendations and refresh actions are grouped in one clear panel.

sections.heading: A consistent BlackLanturn style
bullets: Settings, Kodi dialogs and Installer menus use the same charcoal and cyan treatment.
Silver and Smoked Glass apply across branded menu icons, genre choices and YouTube category artwork.

sections.heading: Refresh without losing your place
bullets: Reload a list, refresh title information or check for new episodes from Options.
Current titles and your browsing position stay available if a refresh cannot finish.

sections.heading: Your setup stays yours
bullets: Accounts, playback preferences, saved titles, progress and other add-ons stay in place.
Included add-ons and their tested BlackLanturn fixes continue to update together.
